name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It sharpens fine details in video frames without blurring edges, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality by 0.5–1%—proven in tests. The trade-off is a 15% slower render time, but the quality gain outweighs it for high-stakes projects.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s motion blur—it’s a spatial fix, not temporal. The real risk is wasted effort: motion blur demands frame interpolation or temporal denoising, not depth tricks. Test InstantX-ComfyUI’s motion-aware upscaler instead; if it cuts blur by 0.5% without tanking speed, it’s worth it—otherwise, pivot to Flowframes or RIFE for motion clarity.
